issues.jp_before: 試験[しけん]{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{に|maeni-atode}、早[はや]く寝[ね]ました。
issues.problem: 'Went to bed early before the exam' is unnatural; natives say 試験の前の日は早く寝ました.
issues.action: Rewrote as 試験の前に、もう一度ノートを見ました ('looked over my notes once more before the exam').

issues.jp_before: 日本[にほん]{に|ni-destination}着[つ]いた後[あと]{で/に|maeni-atode}、すぐ家族[かぞく]{に|ni-target}電話[でんわ]しました。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot: へ is also natural with 着く but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 急[いそ]いで走[はし]った{とき|toki-when}、転[ころ]びました。
issues.problem: Unnatural: a native would say 走ったら転んだ. With とき the sentence sounds forced.
issues.action: Rewrote as 階段を降りるとき、転びました, d=[たら,まで,ながら]; と avoided because 降りると could also be read as a sequence.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{が|ga-sub-clause}降[ふ]った{とき|toki-when}{は/に|wa-topic}、家[いえ]{で|de-place}本[ほん]{を|o-object}読[よ]みます。
issues.problem: Past 降った for a habitual 'when it rains' is marked; 降るとき is the natural form.
issues.action: Changed to 降るとき. Swapped distractors to [ながら,まで,まえに] because 降ると is acceptable for a habit. Updated why.

issues.jp_before: 暑[あつ]い{とき|toki-when}、冷[つめ]たいお茶[ちゃ]{を|o-object}飲[の]みたいです。
issues.problem: 飲みたいです for a general habit is unnatural.
issues.action: Rewrote as 暑いときは、冷たいお茶が飲みたくなります, with slots {は/に|wa-topic} and {が/を|ga-stative}. Updated the English.

issues.jp_before: 学校[がっこう]{に|ni-destination}着[つ]いた{とき|toki-when}、まだ誰[だれ]{も|mo-total-negation}いませんでした。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot: へ is also natural with 着く but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: お金[かね]{が|ga-existence}なかった{とき|toki-when}、友[とも]だち{に|ni-source}借[か]りました。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot: から is just as natural with 借りる but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 日本語[にほんご]{が|ga-subject}分[わ]からなかった{とき|toki-when}、辞書[じしょ]{を|o-object}引[ひ]きました。
issues.problem: Wrong skill id: が with 分かる belongs to ga-stative.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to ga-stative.

issues.jp_before: 出[で]かける{とき|toki-when}{は/に|wa-topic}、かぎ{を|o-object}忘[わす]れないでください。
issues.problem: Distractor ので is grammatical ('since you are going out, don't forget your key') and close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced ので with と, which cannot be followed by a request.
